description: Turn a loose idea into a production-ready image or video prompt — the same Dreamer engine the FilmLab web UI uses (modes: beautify, storyboard, polish, format, shorten, expand, simplify, custom, stiluebernahme). beautify GENERATES (a 50-character thought comes back as a full prompt); polish/format/shorten/expand/simplify PRESERVE what is there. medium=video plus depth=skeleton yields the 15-block production prompt; depth only applies to video. anlass only applies to beautify. custom and stiluebernahme require instruction. For video the answer carries clip_duration_seconds — hand THAT number to lab_animate(duration_seconds), otherwise a prompt timed to 12s gets rendered as lab_animate's 5s default. In an Apps-capable host this opens as a form you can adjust and re-run; elsewhere it answers with the prompt as plain text. Pass `tool` (the registry key you will hand to lab_animate/lab_generate) and the finished prompt is laid out in the skeleton of that model family — location, camera, lens and light land where that family reads them, worded the way it reads them; families without a measured rule keep them appended as before, and the answer says so (prompt_skelett).

anlass.description: beautify only: what the image is FOR. Default frei

depth.description: video only: sketch (5 blocks, default) or skeleton (15 blocks)

duration_seconds.description: video only: the clip length in seconds the ACTION TIMING beats are written to. Default 5 (what lab_animate renders without an explicit duration). Rejected for medium=photo.

familie.description: Optional, instead of tool: the model family by name when no registry key is at hand. Medium decides whether the image or the video skeleton applies.

groesse.description: Optional: change the shot size of the EXISTING prompt, keeping subject, light and place — a key such as ews, ws, mws, ms, mcu, cu, ecu, macro. Implies mode=custom and needs no instruction. An unknown key is rejected with the known ones.

instruction.description: Required for custom (an order, e.g. 'make it darker') and stiluebernahme (a style description)

location_id.description: Optional, only with tool or familie: the location board whose prompt prefix becomes the place block — the same board you will hand to lab_animate/lab_generate.

medium.description: photo (default) or video — decides the section layout

mode.description: Default beautify (generates). beautify: Aus der Idee einen vollständigen Prompt bauen — ergänzt Licht, Optik, Kamera, Stimmung | storyboard: Szene in 4–8 nummerierte Panels zerlegen — je Panel ein eigenständiger Bild-Prompt | polish: Wortwahl polieren, Flow verbessern, Redundanz entfernen — Länge bleibt | format: In // Subject // Lighting // Camera Sektionen ordnen, Wortlaut bleibt | shorten: ~30% kürzer, jedes Wort muss Gewicht tragen | expand: Texturen, Lichtreflexe, atmosphärische Details | simplify: Direkt und klar, weniger Fachjargon | custom: Eigene Anweisung — z.B. 'Mach es düsterer' | stiluebernahme: Licht, Optik und Look aus einer Beschreibung — Motiv und Bildaufbau bleiben wörtlich

project_id.description: Optional, only with tool or familie: the project whose Lens Lab optics, Pose Director framing and gaffer light should be laid into the prompt.

prompt.description: The text to work on — a loose thought is enough for beautify

referenzen.description: The references the prompt may point at, IN THE ORDER you will pass them to lab_animate/lab_propose. Write @bild1, @video1, @ton1 in your prompt and they come back as the markers the model actually reads (@Image1, @Video2, @Audio1) — the reference clip itself is @Video1, so the first video reference is @Video2. A mention with no matching reference is rejected instead of being left in the text, where it would reach the model as a word.

art.description: Which channel this reference goes into: bild an image, video a clip, ton a sound.

id.description: The reference as an ID — optional here for the same reason.

rolle.description: WHICH character or place this reference means. Carried into the mapping the answer returns.

url.description: Address of the reference — optional here: the Dreamer only needs the ORDER and the channel, not the file.

techniken.description: Up to three directing technique keys from lab_regie_techniken. Their prompt fragments are appended verbatim after the transform, ordered angle, framing, composition, movement. One angle and one movement at most; movement only with medium=video.

tool.description: Optional: the model you will render with, as the registry key from lab_list_models. Decides which family skeleton lays out camera, lens and light — and whether it is a measured rule or the plain appended form.

winkel.description: Optional: change the camera angle of the EXISTING prompt — a key such as augen, unter, auf, vogel, frosch, schraeg, ots, pov, profil. Implies mode=custom and needs no instruction; combinable with groesse.
